scope: Shared concrete numeric identities, core type descriptions, checked storage widths and explicit type capability gates; arithmetic remains float32-only.

semantics.catalogue: Signed/unsigned 8/16/32/64-bit integers plus float32/float64, with canonical name, family and width. int/uint/float resolve to fixed 64-bit equivalents.
semantics.availability: Descriptions do not enable arithmetic. Source and CPU/Apple GPU arithmetic support remain float32-only; integer private storage formats do not enable integer kernels.
semantics.identity: ValueType carries explicit scalar/tensor element identity through semantics and continuation slots. Type conformance and arithmetic/branch joins compare identity, not byte width.
semantics.sizes: Shared checkedNumericBytes validates identity and count against an explicit byte limit. Semantic allocation checks and private Metal storage use these widths; invalid identities are rejected even for zero counts.
semantics.gates: CPU scalar/tensor and task lowering reject unsupported numeric metadata before float32 lowering; Metal frame and GPU closure admission retain explicit numeric capability checks.
semantics.abi: Existing Float32Tensor memref and scalar ValueLayout ABI remain unchanged. The descriptor does not prescribe a target ABI or serialized protocol identity.
semantics.remaining: Element-aware CPU storage/ABI and actual per-type arithmetic, literal/conversion, operator and GPU conformance remain ahead. Deferred extended numeric formats are not added.

coverage: all byte widths at maximum counts and explicit limits
invalid/deferred type names and invalid target identities
same-width uint32 metadata rejected on function result/declared result/symbol/expression surfaces
typed task continuation identity retained independently of execution support
existing semantic overflow and explicit shape tests
full CPU/GPU arithmetic and ownership/lifecycle regression

distributed_execution: Not implemented; design-review gate retained in docs/roadmap.md.
performance: Numeric type infrastructure/correctness increment; no performance claim.
